messages.subject: GoogleVis styling customizations
parts:
I am trying to figure out how much I could really push the custom styling with google charts within shiny. Specifically change background color, line color sets, fonts, etc.

Below is example of googleVis annotated time line I am working on (server.R). The component has various customizations I am looking but they are not being rendered within shiny app. Is there a way to customized this specific component? 

  output$cume_v_time_fig <- renderGvis({
    cume_v_time_fig <- gvisAnnotatedTimeLine(custom_d_stats_src, 
                                             datevar = 'reported_date', 
                                             numvar ='cume', 
                                             idvar ='stream_platform',
                                             options=list(displayAnnotations=TRUE,
                                                          legendPosition='newRow',
                                                          allowHtml=TRUE,
                                                          width=535, height=350,
                                                          backgroundColor="#272727",
                                                          vAxis="{gridlines:{color:'red', count:3}}"
                                             )
                                      )})

Thx
